mapper.select: SELECT MIN(TRANSACTION_DATE) AS firstDate, MAX(TRANSACTION_DATE) AS lastDate FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId}

SELECT MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE) AS month, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(PRE_TAX_INCOME), 0), 0) AS amount FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'INCOME' GROUP BY MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE) ORDER BY MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE)

SELECT MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE) AS month, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(AMOUNT), 0), 0) AS amount FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'EXPENSE' GROUP BY MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE) ORDER BY MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'EXPENSE'
